note: What a server sends to place a prop on the field: a thing that stands there and is looked at rather than one that acts.

fields.name: prop
fields.note: The name the prop answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which of the sender's runs of names this one is drawn from.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which look the prop wears.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the prop stands, along one ground axis.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where the prop stands, in height.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where the prop stands, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: facingX
fields.note: Which way it faces, along one ground axis.

fields.name: facingY
fields.note: Which way it faces, in height.

fields.name: facingZ
fields.note: Which way it faces, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: offsetX
fields.note: What is added to where it stands, along one ground axis.

fields.name: offsetY
fields.note: What is added to where it stands, in height.

fields.name: offsetZ
fields.note: What is added to where it stands, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: scaleX
fields.note: What its drawn size is scaled by, along each axis, along one ground axis.

fields.name: scaleY
fields.note: What its drawn size is scaled by, along each axis, in height.

fields.name: scaleZ
fields.note: What its drawn size is scaled by, along each axis, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: team
fields.note: The side it belongs to, or zero where it belongs to none.

fields.name: rank
fields.note: How far it is advanced.

fields.name: skillLevel
fields.note: What level its own doings stand at.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of prop it is.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What this prop is called, so a client can tell one from another. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art and sound under, written and padded as above.
